answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 15532 Country: Bangladesh Title: Assalaamu A'laikum. Hazrat is it permissible in Islam to do lectureship in universities in MBA(Finance)? I am dubious as in finance i will have to teach interest banking insurance etc. Question: Assalaamu A'laikum. Hazrat is it permissible in Islam to do lectureship in universities in MBA (Finance)? I am dubious as in finance i will have to teach interest banking insurance etc. Answer ID: 15532 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1428/1360/B=1430) Teaching about interest, banking and insurance is right. To become a lecturer in order to teach such subjects is right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
